verdict.rationale: Grafana documents collecting metrics, logs, and traces (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Alloy/OpenTelemetry) and querying them together in one platform. It also documents pivoting with shared context: metrics-to-logs with preserved label filters, exemplars that jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces, linking traces with logs and metrics, and incident investigation using the same signals that fired the alert. A community user corroborates getting metrics, logs, and tracing together in Grafana Cloud, though one early hands-on report struggled to explore Loki logs at launch. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the cross-signal pivot workflows (trace-to-logs and metrics-to-traces) beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: It helps you collect metrics, logs, traces, and profiles from your applications
enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored
Experience the magic of switching from metrics to logs with preserved label filters.
Prometheus exemplars let you jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces by clicking on recorded exemplars.
link your tracing data with logs and metrics
During an incident, you can investigate with the same metrics, logs, and traces that fired the alert.
